collection.credit:
HEATHEN-ONLY EVENTS (HE-01 to HE-45, draft for the owner, 2026-11-23, target v1.35.98)
New Believers only. Island events about the Heathens' own lives: honoring their dead, Heathen versions of events our villagers already have, and small moments of camp life.

collection.description: A Heathen has had a long day, and the warm pools are steaming in the moonlight.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The warm pools are the Heathens' favourite place on the island. (name1) has had a long day and the water is steaming in the moonlight.

variants.text: The warm pools are the Isolans' favourite place on the island. (name1) has had a long day and the water is steaming in the moonlight.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) soaks until (his/her) fingers wrinkle and every ache is gone. (He/she) walks back to camp so relaxed (he/she) forgets (his/her) mask on the rocks, and has to go back for it.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (name1) has a quick dip and heads back. On the way (he/she) passes a villager going the other way, with a towel and a guilty expression. They pretend not to see each other. It is, by now, a sort of tradition.
